changeReason: Test whether query-intent protection and bounded correction-triggered extra slots reduce false invalidation or recover current-state evidence. Candidate selection uses only weekly/monthly feedback. Quarterly results were observed in prior v1 work, so they are a confirmation set rather than a pristine holdout for this new method.

queryIntent.classifier: deterministic query-text classifier in the replaceable Memora adapter

optimizer.quality: mean evidenceFamaProxy on optimization-period forgetting-bearing questions
optimizer.harm: mean positive evidenceFamaProxy loss on optimization-period non-forgetting questions
optimizer.cost: mean positive injected-token increase over Base on all optimization-period questions, in kilotokens
